//: Type-checks the E6.2 race suites. Deliberately NOT added to the root tsconfig.json's
`playwright.config.*` -- not the root tsconfig. Wiring it in is a one-line follow-up for
whoever owns that file; until then run `npx tsc -p tests` (npm run test:e2e:types).
Playwright compiles these files itself at run time via its own transform, so this config is
an editor/CI checking aid rather than something the runner depends on.
